description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Saudi Arabia Saudi Central Bank financial institutions result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when financial-institution scope only. MHRSD business-sector leave, RTGS-specific intervals, government offices, private-employer rosters, Hajj-season branch exceptions and Umm al-Qura forecasts are not inferred.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Friday-Saturday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2029 authority events.
Example user requests: Saudi Arabia: SAMA Eid Al-Fitr interval. | Saudi Arabia: Friday/Saturday weekly baseline. | Saudi Arabia: National Day Saturday substitution.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-03-17"} | {"date":"2026-01-02"} | {"date":"2028-09-24"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Friday/Saturday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/saudi-financial-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/saudi-financial-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in Saudi Arabia coverage.

name: check_sa_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Exact SAMA financial-institution holiday intervals plus the annual National Day and Founding Day rules.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: SAMA states that National Day or Founding Day on Friday moves to Thursday and on Saturday moves to Sunday; the 2028 National Day substitute is included. Other employer or RTGS substitutions are not inferred.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Saudi Arabia Working Day
